maria: Quick sync — LockLynx + FortressKey BYOK/HSM for Azure Marketplace. Are we still on track for the Nov 21 announcement? @samir @jess
samir: Need final SAML SP metadata and SCIM attribute map from LockLynx. Security also wants cert rotation window + test tenant creds.
jess: SCIM 2.0 mappings are ready. We'll need LockLynx test tenant and a sample HSM key policy. Can someone paste the partner metadata when you get it?
ryan: Marketing wants a one-pager by EOD Thu. Legal says embargo until 11/29, don't post before that. :lock:
maria: LockLynx replied by email and attached SP metadata — pasting the link they sent: https://staging.locklynx.partners/saml/metadata.xml
jess: On BYOK/HSM side we need the envelope key flow enabled. Example policy flag they must set: `allowExternalWrap: true`. Ops, can you validate that against FortressKey's spec?
ops-bot: helm diff --namespace marketplace ./charts/locklynx-fortresskey | cat -> no changes detected
maria: Can infra schedule a brief smoke test Wed 10:30am PST? @ops-bot
ops-bot: scheduled: marketplace-smoke-locklynx 2025-11-19T10:30:00Z
legal: Confirmed embargo until 2025-11-29 00:00 UTC; route press draft to legal-review@redwood.com for signoff.
samir: I'll follow up with LockLynx PM for tenant creds and the cert chain. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
